description: This file contains a class 'KeyManagementEventHooks' with static asynchronous methods that handle post-operation logic for key management actions such as key generation, update, rotation, and deletion. It includes logging, notification, and secret management integration.

classes.name: KeyManagementEventHooks
classes.description: A collection of static asynchronous methods for handling post-key management events such as creation, update, rotation, and deletion, including logging, notifications, and secret management.

methods.name: async_key_generated_hook( data: GenerateKeyRequest, response: GenerateKeyResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles actions after a key is generated, such as sending email notifications, logging audit logs, and storing the key in a secret manager.

methods.name: async_key_updated_hook( data: UpdateKeyRequest, existing_key_row: Any, response: Any, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles actions after a key is updated, notably creating audit logs.

methods.name: async_key_rotated_hook( data: Optional[RegenerateKeyRequest], existing_key_row: LiteLLM_VerificationToken, response: GenerateKeyResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles actions after a key rotation, including secret rotation, email notification, and audit logging.

methods.name: async_key_deleted_hook( data: KeyRequest, keys_being_deleted: List[LiteLLM_VerificationToken], response: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles actions after keys are deleted, including logging and removing secrets from secret management.

methods.name: _store_virtual_key_in_secret_manager( secret_name: str, secret_token: str, team_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Stores a virtual key in the secret manager securely.

methods.name: _rotate_virtual_key_in_secret_manager( current_secret_name: str, new_secret_name: str, new_secret_value: str )
methods.description: Rotates an existing virtual key within the secret manager.

methods.name: str _get_secret_name(secret_name: str)
methods.description: Generates the full secret name based on configured prefix.

methods.name: _delete_virtual_keys_from_secret_manager( keys_being_deleted: List[LiteLLM_VerificationToken], )
methods.description: Deletes virtual keys from the secret manager, batch operation.

methods.name: Optional[dict] _get_secret_manager_optional_params( team_id: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves optional parameters for secret management based on team_id.

methods.name: bool _is_email_sending_enabled()
methods.description: Checks whether email notifications are configured and enabled.

methods.name: _send_key_created_email(response: dict)
methods.description: Sends notification email after a key is created, if enabled.

methods.name: _send_key_rotated_email( response: dict, existing_key_alias: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Sends notification email after a key is rotated, if enabled.
